findings.title: Repository metadata
findings.review_note: Use this metadata as context for other findings.

findings.title: GitHub Actions repository permissions
evidence: The sample observation allowed all actions and did not require SHA pinning.
findings.review_note: Review allowed actions and SHA pinning requirements against repository policy.
limitations: This sample does not assert the current allowed_actions value.

findings.title: GITHUB_TOKEN default workflow permissions
evidence: Default workflow permission was read in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Keep the default workflow token permission read-only unless a workflow needs write access explicitly.

findings.title: Repository rulesets
evidence: The sample observation returned an empty rulesets array.
findings.review_note: Add a default-branch ruleset or manually confirm equivalent legacy branch protection.
limitations: Legacy branch protection is not checked by v0.1.

findings.title: CodeQL default setup
evidence: CodeQL default setup was not configured in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Enable CodeQL default setup if this repository contains supported code that should be scanned.

findings.title: Dependabot security updates
evidence: Automated security fixes were disabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Enable Dependabot security updates where compatible with the repository workflow.

findings.title: Dependabot vulnerability alerts
evidence: The sample observation did not receive the enabled 204 status.
findings.review_note: Confirm whether Dependabot vulnerability alerts should be enabled.
limitations: A 404 can also indicate unavailable feature or access constraints depending on context.

findings.title: Secret scanning
evidence: Repository metadata reported secret scanning enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Keep secret scanning enabled and avoid exposing secret values in audit output.

findings.title: Secret scanning push protection
evidence: Repository metadata reported secret scanning push protection enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Keep push protection enabled unless repository policy explicitly requires otherwise.

findings.title: Open Dependabot alerts
findings.review_note: Enable or grant access to Dependabot alerts, then re-run the audit.
limitations: Dependabot alert listing was unavailable in the sample observation.

findings.title: Open secret scanning alerts
evidence: The sample observation returned zero open secret scanning alerts.
findings.review_note: Continue monitoring secret scanning alerts. Do not include secret values in audit output.

findings.title: Open code scanning alerts
findings.review_note: Configure code scanning before relying on code scanning alert counts.
limitations: Code scanning alerts were unavailable because no analysis was found in the sample observation.

limitations.detail: Dependabot alert listing was unavailable in the sample observation.
